name: Australian Journeys
intro: Australian Journeys is a Melbourne-based private tour operator founded in 2019. They run exclusively private wine and food tours to the Mornington Peninsula for groups of 2 to 11, with door-to-door pickup and flexible itineraries. Larger buses up to 24 seats are available for bigger groups.
whatGoodAt: The all-private format means no shared coach with strangers. A flexible fleet across SUV, 11-seater minibus, and 24-seater bus allows the same operator to handle couples through to larger group bookings. Free cancellation up to 24 hours is a practical booking safeguard.
notSuitedFor: Solo travellers or couples looking for a budget day tour, as the private model and pricing from $374 per person reflects premium positioning. No Tripadvisor review history available in the CSV data to validate guest satisfaction independently.
